Quick answers and next steps:
- Rooms: Summit Suite (exec room, AV cart, 12-person) and Atrium B (large conference, fixed projector) are our standard demo spaces. Summit Suite is quieter; Atrium B is better if you need lab access later.
- NDA: we prefer a mutual NDA signed ahead of the visit for demo materials. I'll attach our standard HQ NDA template for your legal team to review. If you can sign via DocuSign that works fine.
- Parking & access: we can provide two visitor lot passes and one EV charging code. Please send full attendee names + mobile numbers and any dietary restrictions.

Proposed slots:
- Tue 2028-06-20: 10:00–12:00 (Summit Suite)
- Wed 2028-06-21: 14:00–16:00 (Atrium B)

If both look okay, I'll tentatively hold Summit Suite for Tue and ask Facilities to prepare an AV kit. If not, tell me which slot you prefer and when you expect to send the signed NDA.
